business_summary: Tianjin MOTIMO Membrane Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of ultra- and micro filtration membranes, membrane modules, and membrane equipment. The company also provides hollow fiber column and fiber curtain membrane modules, continuous membrane filtration (CMF) equipment, submerged membrane filtration (SMF) equipment, membrane bioreactors (MBR), industrial special separation and integrated membrane equipment, and HPS clarifier equipment used for municipal and industrial water purification, wastewater treatment and reuse, unconventional water resource utilization, and the separation, concentration, and purification of industrial materials solutions. In addition, it offers technical support and after-sales service. The company was formerly known as Tianjin MOTIMO Membrane Technology Co.,Ltd and changed its name to Tianjin MOTIMO Membrane Technology Group Co., Ltd. in July 2025. The company was founded in 1974 and is headquartered in Tianjin, the People's Republic of China.
